reopenReason:
REJECTED 4th TIME — Only change from prior rejection: AuditExport imported+rendered (good). But ALL 3 core DoD failures remain:

1. COLUMNS: Still 5 columns (Time, Action, Actor, Resource, Message). DoD requires 7 SEPARATE columns: timestamp, event type, actor, resource type, resource ID, action, message. Currently "Resource" merges resourceType+resourceId (line 83) and "Action" shows eventType (line 77).

2. SORTING: Still no sortable column headers. Need useState for sort field+direction, a SortableHeader component (or click handler on th), and sorted data passed to the table.

3. PAGINATION: Still renders all entries at once. Need page state, Previous/Next buttons, and slice the entries array (e.g. PER_PAGE=20).

4. TIMESTAMPS: formatTimestamp (line 9) uses toLocaleString() which omits milliseconds. Epic rail requires "Timestamps at millisecond precision". Use: `d.toISOString().replace('T',' ').replace('Z','')` or similar to show ms.

EXACT FIX: Rewrite AuditLogPage.tsx with 7 th columns, sort state+handler, page state+controls, and ISO timestamp formatting with .SSS precision.
